t: Amda Seyon一世,埃塞俄比亚皇帝开始在南部穆斯林省份进行竞选.
te: Amda Seyon I, Emperor of Ethiopia begins his campaigns in the southern Muslim provinces.
dz: Amda Seyon一世,埃塞俄比亚皇帝开始在南部穆斯林省份进行竞选.
de: Amda Seyon I, Emperor of Ethiopia begins his campaigns in the southern Muslim provinces.

t: 杜普林荒原之战：马尔伯爵多姆纳尔二世领导下的苏格兰人被爱德华·巴利奥尔击溃。
te: Battle of Dupplin Moor: Scots under Domhnall II, Earl of Mar are routed by Edward Balliol.
dz: 苏格兰独立战争：杜普林荒原之战：马尔伯爵多姆纳尔二世领导下的苏格兰人被爱德华·巴利奥尔击溃。
de: Wars of Scottish Independence: Battle of Dupplin Moor: Scots under Domhnall II, Earl of Mar are routed by Edward Balliol.

t: 林钦活佛可汗成为了蒙古人和元朝皇帝的克哈干,仅统治了53天.
te: Rinchinbal Khan becomes the Khagan of the Mongols and Emperor of the Yuan dynasty, reigning for only 53 days.
dz: 林钦活佛可汗成为了蒙古人和元朝皇帝的克哈干,仅统治了53天.
de: Rinchinbal Khan becomes the Khagan of the Mongols and Emperor of the Yuan dynasty, reigning for only 53 days.
